findings.summary: The prompt's git diff exclude set omits .dd-evidence/, which is part of the reserved metadata prefix set used elsewhere in the contract (audit.py METADATA_PREFIXES, git_ops._RESERVED_PREFIXES, dd_replay.RESERVED_PREFIXES all define (".dev-dispatch/", ".dd-evidence/")). The prompt at prompt.py:215 uses only ':(exclude).dev-dispatch'. No practical impact in normal review flow since .dd-evidence/ is only written by the acceptance stage (runs after reviews), but deviates from the spec's 'exact product path set used elsewhere in the plugin contract' requirement.
